items.title: NXP Semiconductors (NASDAQ:NXPI) Q2: Beats On Revenue But Stock Drops
items.summary: Chip manufacturer NXP Semiconductors (NASDAQ: NXPI) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 19.5% year on year to $3.5 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $3.75 billion at the midpoint, 1.1% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.61 per share was 2.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
